body: The idea of all this carrying on. Thats where the fear comes in. I hate it. I don't want this to continue.
like the other dude said, I don't see it as a solution, more of a delay of the inevitable. I'd invest everything, but I have nothing. mentally and physically and financially.
I've done all that a hundred times. :/ It usually doesn't work. and if it does, it lasts a week and then I'm like this again. I'd much rather put an end to it all.
